# ===== CELL 1 : imports + parameters =====
from pyspark.sql import functions as F, Window as W
from pyspark.sql.types import TimestampType

STORAGE_ACCOUNT  = "navispowerbidatastorage2"
SRC_FORMAT       = "delta"                 # delta | parquet | csv
TERMINAL         = "DGT"                   # YardID filter, None = all
CONTAINER        = "dgt"                   # the container is named after the terminal
SRC_PATH         = f"abfss://{CONTAINER}@{STORAGE_ACCOUNT}.dfs.core.windows.net/silver/ecevents"

spark.conf.set("spark.sql.session.timeZone", "UTC")   # keep timestamps exactly as stored

print("source path :", SRC_PATH)
print("format      :", SRC_FORMAT)
print("terminal    :", TERMINAL)

# ===== CELL 2 : read silver ecEvents =====
rd = spark.read.format(SRC_FORMAT)
if SRC_FORMAT == "csv":
    rd = rd.option("header", True).option("inferSchema", True)
raw = rd.load(SRC_PATH)
print("rows read:", raw.count())
raw.printSchema()

# ===== CELL 3 : clean + keep only SC rows that belong to a move =====
# adapt the delta schema to the column names used in the later cells
RENAMES = {"cheID": "CHE_ID", "OPERATOR_ID": "operator_name"}

REQUIRED = ["ecEventGkey", "YardID", "cheKind", "CHE_Name", "cheID", "EcEventTime", "eventTypeDescription",
            "unit", "pow", "pool", "workQueue", "travelDistance", "moveKind", "isTwin",
            "startDistance", "workAssignment", "OPERATOR_ID"]
missing = [c for c in REQUIRED if c not in raw.columns]
assert not missing, f"missing columns in silver ecevents: {missing}"
assert isinstance(raw.schema["EcEventTime"].dataType, TimestampType), \
    f"EcEventTime is {raw.schema['EcEventTime'].dataType}, expected timestamp"

ev = raw
for old, new in RENAMES.items():
    ev = ev.withColumnRenamed(old, new)

ev = (ev
      .withColumn("ts", F.col("EcEventTime"))
      .withColumn("evt", F.trim("eventTypeDescription"))
      .withColumn("workAssignment", F.col("workAssignment").cast("long"))
      .withColumn("unit", F.trim("unit"))
      .filter(F.col("ts").isNotNull())
      .dropDuplicates(["ecEventGkey"]))

if TERMINAL:
    ev = ev.filter(F.upper(F.col("YardID")) == TERMINAL.upper())

# AVAL / UNAV / LGON / LGOF / plain IDLE have no workAssignment -> equipment state, not a move
sc = ev.filter((F.col("cheKind") == "SC") & F.col("workAssignment").isNotNull())
print("SC rows with a workAssignment:", sc.count())

# ===== CELL 4 : one header row per move (key = CHE_Name + workAssignment) =====
# Unit / MoveKind / etc. come from the LadenTo row (LTSH, LTRW, LTGD) - the row that defines a valid move.
# Fallback 1: the dispatch row. Fallback 2: the first row of the move.
KEY  = ["CHE_Name", "workAssignment"]
META = ["unit", "moveKind", "pow", "pool", "workQueue", "isTwin", "operator_name",
        "CHE_ID", "travelDistance", "startDistance", "YardID"]
LADEN_TO_CODES = ["LTSH", "LTRW", "LTGD"]
DISPATCH_CODES = ["DSPT", "ETRW", "ETSH", "ETGD"]

meta_struct = F.struct("ts", "ecEventGkey", *META)

hdr = (sc.groupBy(*KEY)
         .agg(F.min(F.when(F.col("evt").isin(LADEN_TO_CODES), meta_struct)).alias("_l"),
              F.min(F.when(F.col("evt").isin(DISPATCH_CODES), meta_struct)).alias("_d"),
              F.min(meta_struct).alias("_f"),
              F.collect_set("unit").alias("_units"),
              F.count("*").alias("n_events"),
              F.min("ts").alias("first_event_time"),
              F.max("ts").alias("last_event_time")))

for c in META:
    hdr = hdr.withColumn(c, F.coalesce(F.col("_l")[c], F.col("_d")[c], F.col("_f")[c]))

hdr = (hdr.withColumn("all_units", F.concat_ws("|", F.array_sort("_units")))
          .withColumn("n_units", F.size("_units"))
          .drop("_l", "_d", "_f", "_units")
          .withColumnRenamed("moveKind", "move_kind"))

# only the 4 move kinds in scope
KINDS = ["LOAD", "DSCH", "RECV", "DLVR"]
hdr = hdr.filter(F.col("move_kind").isin(KINDS))
print("moves in scope:", hdr.count())
hdr.groupBy("move_kind").count().show()

# ===== CELL 5 : event-code mapping per move kind (edit here if the rule changes) =====
# order inside each list = order of priority
EVENT_MAP = {
    "LOAD": {"dispatch": ["DSPT", "ETRW"], "unladen_arrive": ["EARW"], "laden_to": ["LTSH"],
             "laden_arrival": ["LASH"], "complete": ["DROP", "IDLE"]},
    "DSCH": {"dispatch": ["DSPT", "ETSH"], "unladen_arrive": ["EASH"], "laden_to": ["LTRW"],
             "laden_arrival": ["LARW"], "complete": ["DROP", "IDLE"]},
    "RECV": {"dispatch": ["DSPT", "ETGD"], "unladen_arrive": ["EAGD"], "laden_to": ["LTRW"],
             "laden_arrival": ["LARW"], "complete": ["DROP", "IDLE"]},
    "DLVR": {"dispatch": ["DSPT", "ETRW"], "unladen_arrive": ["EARW"], "laden_to": ["LTGD"],
             "laden_arrival": ["LAGD"], "complete": ["DROP", "IDLE"]},
}
OUT_COLS = ["dispatch_time", "unladen_arrive", "laden_to", "laden_arrival", "complete_time"]
STAGE_TO_COL = dict(zip(["dispatch", "unladen_arrive", "laden_to", "laden_arrival", "complete"], OUT_COLS))

ALL_CODES = sorted({c for k in EVENT_MAP.values() for codes in k.values() for c in codes})
print("event codes needed:", ALL_CODES)

# ===== CELL 6 : transpose - one timestamp column per event code (first occurrence in the move) =====
sc_k = sc.join(hdr.select(*KEY), KEY, "inner")          # keep only rows of in-scope moves

pivot = (sc_k.filter(F.col("evt").isin(ALL_CODES))
             .groupBy(*KEY)
             .pivot("evt", ALL_CODES)
             .agg(F.min("ts")))
for c in ALL_CODES:
    pivot = pivot.withColumnRenamed(c, f"t_{c}")

wide = hdr.join(pivot, KEY, "left")
wide.select("CHE_Name", "workAssignment", "unit", "move_kind", *[f"t_{c}" for c in ALL_CODES]).show(5, truncate=False)

# ===== CELL 7 : build the 5 columns by move kind (blank = event not found) =====
def pick(kind, stage):
    cols = [F.col(f"t_{c}") for c in EVENT_MAP[kind][stage]]
    return cols[0] if len(cols) == 1 else F.coalesce(*cols)

result = wide
for stage, out in STAGE_TO_COL.items():
    expr = None
    for kind in KINDS:
        cond = F.col("move_kind") == kind
        expr = F.when(cond, pick(kind, stage)) if expr is None else expr.when(cond, pick(kind, stage))
    result = result.withColumn(out, expr)

# valid move = the move kind's LadenTo event exists (nothing else is checked)
result = result.withColumn("is_valid", F.col("laden_to").isNotNull())

lead = ["CHE_Name", "workAssignment", "unit", "all_units", "n_units", "move_kind", *OUT_COLS, "is_valid",
        "pow", "pool", "workQueue", "isTwin", "operator_name", "CHE_ID",
        "travelDistance", "startDistance", "YardID", "n_events", "first_event_time", "last_event_time"]
result = result.select(*lead)

# ===== CELL 8 : sanity checks =====
print("moves:", result.count(), "| valid (has LadenTo):", result.filter("is_valid").count())

(result.groupBy("move_kind")
       .agg(F.count("*").alias("moves"),
            F.sum(F.col("is_valid").cast("int")).alias("valid"),
            *[F.sum(F.col(c).isNull().cast("int")).alias(f"blank_{c}") for c in OUT_COLS])
       .orderBy("move_kind").show())

# the same, restricted to valid moves
(result.filter("is_valid").groupBy("move_kind")
       .agg(F.count("*").alias("valid_moves"),
            *[F.sum(F.col(c).isNull().cast("int")).alias(f"blank_{c}") for c in OUT_COLS])
       .orderBy("move_kind").show())

result.filter("is_valid").orderBy("CHE_Name", "dispatch_time").show(10, truncate=False)

# ===== CELL 9 : write to gold =====
GOLD_PATH = f"abfss://{CONTAINER}@{STORAGE_ACCOUNT}.dfs.core.windows.net/gold/SC_EcEventsTransposed"
(result.write.format("delta").mode("overwrite").option("overwriteSchema", "true").save(GOLD_PATH))
print("written:", GOLD_PATH)

# ===== CELL 9 : derived columns for Power BI (fact_sc_moves) =====
SHIFT_START_HOUR = 6          # day shift 07:00-19:00, night shift 19:00-07:00
SHIFT_LENGTH_H   = 12
MAX_SEC          = 7200       # any duration above this (or negative) is blanked as bad data

def dur(a, b):
    d = F.col(b).cast("long") - F.col(a).cast("long")
    return F.when((d >= 0) & (d <= MAX_SEC), d)

fact = (result.filter("is_valid")
  .withColumn("side", F.when(F.col("move_kind").isin("LOAD", "DSCH"), "WaterSide").otherwise("LandSide"))
  .withColumn("move_start_time", F.coalesce("dispatch_time", "unladen_arrive", "laden_to"))
  .withColumn("shift_date", F.to_date(F.expr(f"move_start_time - interval {SHIFT_START_HOUR} hours")))
  .withColumn("shift", F.when(F.hour("move_start_time").between(SHIFT_START_HOUR, SHIFT_START_HOUR + SHIFT_LENGTH_H - 1),
                              "Day").otherwise("Night"))
  .withColumn("cycle_sec",          dur("dispatch_time", "complete_time"))
  .withColumn("unladen_travel_sec", dur("dispatch_time", "unladen_arrive"))
  .withColumn("pickup_sec",         dur("unladen_arrive", "laden_to"))
  .withColumn("laden_travel_sec",   dur("laden_to", "laden_arrival"))
  .withColumn("drop_sec",           dur("laden_arrival", "complete_time"))
  .withColumn("move_id", F.concat_ws("-", "CHE_Name", F.col("workAssignment").cast("string"))))

# ===== CELL 10 : idle gaps per SC (fact_sc_idle) =====
# idle = time between the end of one move and the start of the next move of the SAME carrier.
# ALL move kinds are used here (incl. SHFT, YARD, rail), otherwise their time would be counted as idle.
IDLE_MAX_SEC    = 3600                       # longer gaps are treated as breaks / out of service
NON_IDLE_EVENTS = ["UNAV", "LGOF", "LGON"]   # SC marked unavailable / logged off-on inside the gap -> not idle

mv_all = (sc.groupBy(*KEY)
  .agg(F.min(F.when(F.col("evt").isin(DISPATCH_CODES), F.col("ts"))).alias("_disp"),
       F.min("ts").alias("_first"),
       F.max(F.when(F.col("evt").isin("DROP", "IDLE", "CMPL"), F.col("ts"))).alias("_done"),
       F.max("ts").alias("_last"),
       F.min(F.when(F.col("evt").isin(DISPATCH_CODES), F.struct("ts", "ecEventGkey", "moveKind"))).alias("_dk"),
       F.min(F.struct("ts", "ecEventGkey", "moveKind")).alias("_fk"))
  .withColumn("start_time", F.coalesce("_disp", "_first"))
  .withColumn("end_time",   F.coalesce("_done", "_last"))
  .withColumn("move_kind",  F.coalesce(F.col("_dk")["moveKind"], F.col("_fk")["moveKind"]))
  .select(*KEY, "move_kind", "start_time", "end_time"))

w      = W.partitionBy("CHE_Name").orderBy("start_time", "workAssignment")
w_prev = w.rowsBetween(W.unboundedPreceding, -1)       # running max handles overlapping moves

gaps = (mv_all
  .withColumn("prev_end",       F.max("end_time").over(w_prev))
  .withColumn("prev_move_kind", F.lag("move_kind").over(w))
  .filter("prev_end is not null")
  .withColumn("idle_sec", F.col("start_time").cast("long") - F.col("prev_end").cast("long"))
  .filter("idle_sec > 0"))

flags = (ev.filter((F.col("cheKind") == "SC") & F.col("evt").isin(NON_IDLE_EVENTS))
           .select(F.col("CHE_Name").alias("f_che"), F.col("ts").alias("f_ts")))

idle = (gaps.join(flags, (gaps.CHE_Name == flags.f_che) & (flags.f_ts >= gaps.prev_end) & (flags.f_ts <= gaps.start_time), "left")
  .groupBy("CHE_Name", "workAssignment", "move_kind", "prev_move_kind", "prev_end", "start_time", "idle_sec")
  .agg(F.count("f_ts").alias("n_unavailable_events"))
  .withColumnRenamed("prev_end", "idle_start_time")
  .withColumnRenamed("start_time", "idle_end_time")
  .withColumnRenamed("move_kind", "next_move_kind")
  .withColumn("next_side", F.when(F.col("next_move_kind").isin("LOAD", "DSCH"), "WaterSide")
                            .when(F.col("next_move_kind").isin("DLVR", "RECV"), "LandSide").otherwise("Other"))
  .withColumn("shift_date", F.to_date(F.expr(f"idle_start_time - interval {SHIFT_START_HOUR} hours")))
  .withColumn("shift", F.when(F.hour("idle_start_time").between(SHIFT_START_HOUR, SHIFT_START_HOUR + SHIFT_LENGTH_H - 1),
                              "Day").otherwise("Night"))
  .withColumn("is_idle_valid", (F.col("n_unavailable_events") == 0) & (F.col("idle_sec") <= IDLE_MAX_SEC)))

# ===== CELL 11 : SC usage per shift (fact_sc_shift_usage) =====
# one row per SC per shift; "straddles used" = distinct CHE_Name (the min-moves threshold is applied in Power BI)
usage = (fact.groupBy("shift_date", "shift", "CHE_Name")
  .agg(F.count("*").alias("moves"),
       F.sum((F.col("side") == "WaterSide").cast("int")).alias("waterside_moves"),
       F.sum((F.col("side") == "LandSide").cast("int")).alias("landside_moves")))

# ===== CELL 12 : write to gold =====
GOLD_BASE = f"abfss://{CONTAINER}@{STORAGE_ACCOUNT}.dfs.core.windows.net/gold/SC_EcEventsTransposed"

outputs = {
    "all_moves":       result,   # every in-scope move, valid or not (what your old cell 9 wrote)
    "fact_sc_moves":   fact,     # valid moves only (has LadenTo) + side, shift, durations -> Power BI
    "fact_sc_idle":    idle,     # idle gaps per SC
    "fact_sc_shift_usage": usage # SCs used per shift
}

for name, df_out in outputs.items():
    path = f"{GOLD_BASE}/{name}"
    df_out.write.format("delta").mode("overwrite").option("overwriteSchema", "true").save(path)
    print("written:", path)
